summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py, rewired site, tickets, escalations, calls, chats, roster, closures, cli and report to use it, and added tests/test_timeparse.py; existing tests pass. Known deviation: out-of-range epochs (e.g. inf) or a 24:00 on date.max now raise ValueError (previously OverflowError/crash) in timeparse; quirks like int() leniency and two-digit/negative years are kept as-is.
